encode_gt_boxes_to_targets: encode ground truth boxes relative to anchors using BoxCoder encode method for ATSS box regression
decode_pred_boxes_from_anchors: decode predicted box offsets back to temporal boundary coordinates using BoxCoder decode method
review_BoxCoder_encode: review the BoxCoder encode method that transforms ground truth boxes into regression targets relative to anchors
review_BoxCoder_decode: review the BoxCoder decode method that reconstructs predicted temporal boxes from regression outputs and anchors
refactor_BoxCoder_regression_weights: refactor the BoxCoder encode and decode methods to parameterize the wx and ww regression weights
